title: Canonical quotient-system isomorphism and pullback factorization
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, Y locally Noetherian, F coherent, y∈Y and p≥0 [def-weil-proper-morphism,pqf-def-locnoeth,pqf-def-coherent]. Put A=O_y, X′=Spec A×_Y X, F′=g′*F, J=m_y O_(X′) and C=H^p(X′,-) restricted to A. There are an A-linear natural isomorphism b from C(F′/J^(n+1)F′) to the infinitesimal fibre cohomology system restricted from the completed local ring, and A-linear maps r_n:H^p(X′,F′)→H^p(X_n,F_n). For every n,z, r_n(z)=b_n C(q_n)(z) and r_n(z)=formalFunctionsFinitePullback(f,y,F,p,n)(z) [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback]. This is the quotient-system/pullback part only, without a stalk comparison or Theta condition.

from.place: Canonical quotient-system isomorphism and pullback factorization in the finite-level portion of the formal-functions input to henselian idempotent lifting.

lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_finite_quotient_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) : let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f' let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅ formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))), ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ, formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y] formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F p n, (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z)) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), r n z = formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z
